title: Noob | Purgatory
description: Noob (forsaken version) as a dlc sinner for purgatory
body:
The very first DLC for [Purgatory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/punishment)!

Adds Noob from roblox (the [Forsaken](https://www.roblox.com/games/18687417158/Forsaken) version)

Very basic sinner to demonstrate custom characters; [Tutorial](https://docs.google.com/document/d/131UnQ3OoHn58YavsnvIWQ7m0-E5T6f4DPGIEeZapQms/edit?usp=sharing).

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pP0Ql8QdX9k" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Abilties:
>- Bloxy Cola - Gives you a temporary speed boost.
>- Slateskin Potion - Makes you temporarily slower and invinicible.
>- Ghostburger - Makes you invisible for a short time.

Most abilties have accurate timing and cooldown to the source material, so it may be unbalanced.

To use, install along with purgatory and run /trigger noob_trigger to select.

Please note I do not condone or associate any negative views the Forsaken team may have, I simply utilised their character because it was simple and recognisable)
